text: One vault, everywhere. Every Deep Cache you place opens the same personal **54-slot** vault, so a chest at home and one at a far outpost hold the same things. A Wayfarer Satchel opens it from your pocket.

pages.title: Opening it
text: Once you have set foot in the March, you are attuned and every opening is free.
Until then, each opening costs **5 Pulse** from a Pulse Cell you carry.
The vault belongs to you, not to the block. Breaking a Deep Cache loses nothing; place another and your things are there.
A lever locks that cache block. The vault itself is never emptied by a pause.

pages.title: The Wayfarer Satchel
text: The satchel opens the same vault from anywhere, with the same attunement rule. It is a key, not a bag: nothing is stored in the item itself, so it cannot be duplicated or lost with its contents.

If you belong to a [shared camp](shared_camps), a Deep Cache or satchel opens the camp's shared vault. Crouch as you open it to switch to your personal vault and back; it remembers your choice. The camp vault is a separate inventory.
